title: Nicole Peña:
title_short: Nicole Peña (CDO) · Welcome to the Family
headline: CASS's development chief started seeing people when she searched under overpasses for a relative. Every case manager and every clean pair of sheets is supporters at work, and 830 people sleep under CASS's roof every night.
story: Nicole had a relative who was homeless. Searching for him under overpasses and in bushes, she suddenly started seeing people.
Turn: what support does. A case manager in the field gets someone into housing; shelter staff bring a clean, fresh pair of sheets.
Proof: 830 people under CASS's roof every night: 600 downtown, 130 at The Haven, 30 families at Vista Colina. Button: welcome to the family. Roll up your sleeves.
do: Open on <q>I had a relative who was homeless.</q> with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Make the support link concrete: case manager, clean sheets.
Put <q>830</q> on screen when she says it, and one shot per shelter as she names it.
Use the side angle (C4900) to hide every join.
End on her smile: <q>Roll up your sleeves.</q>
dont: Don't name the restaurant on screen, and cut the jail line.
Only the lines on this page; nothing from the parts the transcript leaves out or marks do not use.
No dinner footage (client rule for staff videos).
No logo before the end card.
